purpose: Validate the trusted source reader and compare three executable text semantics; not a held-out novelty/precision experiment.
selection: Exhaustive ordered pairs of 16 two-call arm variants; 256 source programs. No data-dependent selection or exclusions.
syntax_amendment: The first batched run exposed E222 in 240 authored sources because fixed prompts declared unused parameters. Correct these to zero-argument prompts/calls. Expected serialized requests, core programs, kernels, selection and endpoints are unchanged. This is a source-generator repair, not evidence of an unsafe source rejection. Both independent readers now reject unused prompt parameters.
transport_amendment: The first frozen run exceeded the Lean 16 MB transport limit when repeated explicit kernel tables were serialized together. All source/core/context files were retained; no Lean executions completed in that attempt. Rerun unchanged cases in batches of 16 and persist process failures. This changes transport, not kernels, selection or endpoints.
source_shape: One root public text input and public Boolean, one secret Boolean branch containing two calls per arm with alpha-renamed locals, followed by a public optional tail call.
kernel: Explicit request-indexed UTF-8 byte tables: Seed:fixed -> z; other Seed requests -> empty ok or é error at 1/2 each; Next: -> ok; Next:é -> xxx; Next:z -> go; Next:constant -> empty ok or x error at 1/2 each; Tail requests -> t. All attempts billed; no source retry.
primary_endpoints: source reader vs independently constructed core
Lean execution vs reference trace distributions
Lean execution vs replay request-and-trace distributions
secondary_endpoints: Record C++ diagnostics under its distinct confidentiality policy; no precision-ranking claim across the different goals
accepted cases under ordinary normalized trace identity; no new-logic claim
failure_policy: Retain every source/context/outcome. Any source mismatch, missing row, process error, wrong diagnostic, semantics disagreement or accepted counterexample fails the campaign; do not count infrastructure errors as semantic rejections.
scope: Trusted Python source reader; shared public values and stateless finite kernels; source budget not certified; no provider validation. Core retries have separate hand-authored conformance cases. Source reader has no mechanized correctness proof. Unit preflight found E230 in the C++ checker because its PC label marks branch-local responses secret; this distinct policy is not a baseline false positive.
